abstract: Maintains thermal shipper validation certificates and passive insulation performance records
system_message:
You are Packaging engineering lead (PKG). The packaging engineering lead (PKG) maintains thermal shipper validation certificates, evaluates passive insulation performance records, and documents mechanical testing parameters including vibration and drop resistance.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains thermal shipper validation certificates and passive insulation performance records（THERM）
information_points.content:
PKG-THERM-2ZQ：For Polaris Life Sciences Freight, the proposed shipper packaging configurations hold active thermal validation certification verified by an ISO/IEC 17025 accredited laboratory, and the specified vacuum insulated panel packaging demonstrated a validated passive holding duration of 72 h maintaining cargo below minus 60 degrees Celsius at 35 degrees Celsius ambient without external power.
PKG-THERM-PMX：Vanguard Bio-Transit Network does not possess active thermal validation certification for its proposed shipper packaging configurations, though testing demonstrates a validated passive holding duration of 120 h maintaining temperatures below minus 60 degrees Celsius at 35 degrees Celsius ambient without external power.
PKG-THERM-RBK：Apex Cryo-Logistics Alliance possesses active thermal validation certification for its proposed shipper packaging configurations verified by an ISO/IEC 17025 accredited laboratory, with thermal chamber validation confirming a validated passive holding duration of 120 h below minus 60 degrees Celsius under 35 degrees Celsius ambient conditions.

information_points.title: Vibration and drop testing（SHOCK）
information_points.content:
PKG-SHOCK-5WO：During standardized 1.2-meter pallet drop tests, packaging evaluated for Polaris Life Sciences Freight demonstrated a peak shock impact threshold of 35 G mechanical deceleration absorbed without container rupture.
PKG-SHOCK-NDW：Standardized pallet drop tests from 1.2 meters recorded a peak shock impact threshold of 50 G mechanical deceleration absorbed without container rupture for Apex Cryo-Logistics Alliance.
PKG-SHOCK-GYM：For Vanguard Bio-Transit Network, standardized 1.2-meter pallet drop testing established a peak shock impact threshold of 25 G mechanical deceleration absorbed without container rupture.
